heading: PromeFTP 1.0.0 is now stable
summary: Use SSH terminals and transfer files from one workspace on your Mac.
changes: Press ⌘, to manage appearance, updates, OpenSSH config, PAM answers, and terminal settings. About shows the running version and build.
Pick an installed monospace font or enter a family name. Preview the result before saving.
Turn on Unlimited scrollback under Terminal to retain output for the current session. The finite line limit is still available.
Save selected tabs and their split layouts. Open them alongside current sessions, then use side-by-side SFTP or split SSH as usual.
notice: Close active SSH, SFTP, and local shells before updating. Existing settings carry over. Requires macOS 13 or later and Apple Silicon.
